The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

To understand blockchain technology, imagine a shared notebook that everyone in a large community has a copy of. Instead of one person holding the only notebook, every participant keeps an identical version. If someone wants to write a new entry, they propose it to the group. The other participants check their own notebooks to verify the information is correct and hasn't been tampered with. Once the majority agrees the entry is valid, everyone writes it down in their own copy at the same time. Because everyone has the same record, it is nearly impossible for anyone to secretly change a past entry without everyone else noticing, making the system highly secure and trustworthy.
